Water Bodies / Geography: Lake Superior; Lake Michigan; Lake Huron; Lake Erie; Lake Ontario; St. Marys River; St. Clair River; Detroit River; St. Lawrence River
System Limits: Atlantic Ocean ↔ Duluth-Superior / inland Great Lakes
Operating Season: Seasonal deep-draft system; domestic lake navigation season extends longer in some segments
Key Vessel Constraints: 225.5 m max length; 23.77 m max beam; 8.08 m max draft; 35.5 m max air draft
Core Authorities: St. Lawrence Seaway Management Corporation; Great Lakes St. Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation; USACE at Soo Locks
Primary Traffic: Bulk cargo; breakbulk; project cargo; containers; cruise; ferries / passenger where applicable
Description: Global trade system linking inland North American industrial and agricultural regions to Atlantic markets.
